exposure: Uterine compression suture placement for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
cohort: Women who experienced postpartum hemorrhage and either received a uterine compression suture or did not, and subsequently had another pregnancy.
finding: Women who received uterine compression sutures had similar overall subsequent obstetrical outcomes but a higher incidence of dense omental adhesions, repeat uterine compression suture application, and intrapartum blood loss.
